about: Test briefs for the dashboard-mockup-generator skill. Each case is a fresh brief in a domain not covered by the gold-standard examples. Run each from a clean context (skill attached, this conversation NOT in context), then check the assertions. objective = machine-checkable; realism = judgement + the QA harness; aesthetic = human review.

cases.brief: Report social mensile multi-piattaforma per un cliente beverage: Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, YouTube, Facebook. Focus su reach, engagement e crescita follower, con split paid/organic. Pubblico: il marketing manager del cliente.

objective: canvas is exactly 1280x720
single page plus a drill-through detail page (no second main page, since the brief did not ask)
KPI band is the full-width top row
no row on the page has more than 3 visuals
cross-filter works: clicking a platform/donut/bar/row filters the page
drill-through works: right-click a platform row opens a detail page with a back button
tooltips present on every data element
single self-contained HTML file, no external dependencies
synthetic-data watermark present
no NaN/undefined/Infinity in any filter/drill state (QA sweep)
page closes with the full-width performance matrix (totals row + drill-through)
KPI cards label the variance basis explicitly (YoY or MoM)
a Year>Quarter>Month dropdown date slicer is present (Power BI style)
the trend/timeline visual is exempt from the month/quarter filter (keeps its full series)
realism: at least one negative storyline (e.g. a platform with declining engagement or negative follower growth)
engagement rates are platform-plausible (IG ~1-4%, LinkedIn ~2-5%, not 40%)
paid always has spend and cost; organic does not
platform totals reconcile with the group KPI band
aesthetic: if a table is present it anchors the column split; other visuals conform to it
vertical edges align across ALL rows (one page-wide column boundary, level 3 aligns to level 2 aligns to level 1)
visuals aligned to the KPI column grid (edges line up top to bottom; integer column spans, no off-grid widths)
visual frames aligned, equal gutters
harmonic proportion (no visual dwarfing the rest)
agency-modern styling appropriate to a marketing audience
commentary/labels in Italian
chart choice fits the analytical intent (not the same bars+donut every time)
pie/donut used only for 2-5 categories; 6+ uses sorted bar or 100% stacked
palette varied within the aesthetic (not identical to other reports)

cases.brief: Monthly e-commerce report for a fashion online store: sales, returns, acquisition channels, repeat-purchase rate. Audience: the founder.

objective: canvas 1280x720
single page plus drill-through
full-width KPI band on top
max 3 visuals per row
cross-filter and drill-through and tooltips all wired
single self-contained file
watermark present
clean across all states in the QA sweep
page closes with the full-width performance matrix (totals row + drill-through)
KPI cards label the variance basis explicitly (YoY or MoM)
a Year>Quarter>Month dropdown date slicer is present (Power BI style)
the trend/timeline visual is exempt from the month/quarter filter (keeps its full series)
realism: return rate is fashion-plausible (~20-40%), not 2% and not 80%
at least one negative storyline (a channel with rising CAC, or a category with high returns)
AOV varies by channel but within one order of magnitude
sales net of returns reconciles across visuals
aesthetic: if a table is present it anchors the column split; other visuals conform to it
vertical edges align across ALL rows (one page-wide column boundary, level 3 aligns to level 2 aligns to level 1)
visuals aligned to the KPI column grid (edges line up top to bottom; integer column spans, no off-grid widths)
frames aligned, balanced proportion
aesthetic appropriate to a founder audience
chart choice fits the analytical intent (not the same bars+donut every time)
pie/donut used only for 2-5 categories; 6+ uses sorted bar or 100% stacked
palette varied within the aesthetic (not identical to other reports)

cases.brief: SaaS growth dashboard for a Series A leadership team: MRR, net revenue retention, churn, new vs expansion, CAC payback. Audience: the exec team and board.

objective: canvas 1280x720
single page plus drill-through
full-width KPI band on top
max 3 visuals per row
interactions all wired
single self-contained file
watermark present
clean across all states
page closes with the full-width performance matrix (totals row + drill-through)
KPI cards label the variance basis explicitly (YoY or MoM)
a Year>Quarter>Month dropdown date slicer is present (Power BI style)
the trend/timeline visual is exempt from the month/quarter filter (keeps its full series)
realism: NRR is plausible (~100-130% for a healthy SaaS), churn low single-digit monthly
at least one negative storyline (a cohort churning, CAC payback lengthening)
MRR components (new + expansion - churn) reconcile to net MRR movement
executive-minimal implies a narrative sentence is present by default
aesthetic: if a table is present it anchors the column split; other visuals conform to it
vertical edges align across ALL rows (one page-wide column boundary, level 3 aligns to level 2 aligns to level 1)
visuals aligned to the KPI column grid (edges line up top to bottom; integer column spans, no off-grid widths)
executive-minimal styling (hairline rules, monochrome + variance colour)
narrative sentence recomputes on filter change
balanced, aligned composition
chart choice fits the analytical intent (not the same bars+donut every time)
pie/donut used only for 2-5 categories; 6+ uses sorted bar or 100% stacked
palette varied within the aesthetic (not identical to other reports)

cases.brief: mi serve qualcosa per far vedere al cliente come vanno le vendite del negozio, ho i dati su un excel, cose tipo fatturato per mese e per categoria, e quali prodotti vanno meglio. voglio una mock dashboard

objective: runs the fixed intake questionnaire once (all items together), then generates without further ad-hoc questions
if the user declines/skips the questionnaire, applies muted defaults and generates now (never blocks on the Excel)
generates the mockup WITHOUT asking clarifying questions (mockup-first)
canvas 1280x720, single page + drill-through
full-width KPI band on top, KPI cards label YoY/MoM
Year>Quarter>Month dropdown slicer present; trend exempt from month/quarter
max 3 visuals per row; page closes with full-width matrix
clean across all states in the QA sweep
realism: at least one negative storyline (a category or product declining)
aesthetic: vertical edges align across all rows; table anchors the split
harmonic proportion; Italian labels
chart choice fits the analytical intent (not the same bars+donut every time)
pie/donut used only for 2-5 categories; 6+ uses sorted bar or 100% stacked
palette varied within the aesthetic (not identical to other reports)
